name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+13 partisan lean strongly favors Democrats
Huffman holds a large cash advantage while Littau shows no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Huffman near certain to win
No public polling, keeping the uncertainty band wide
model.rationale: The district's strong Democratic lean, Huffman's incumbency, and his overwhelming financial edge over a challenger with no visible campaign leave little evidence of a contest. Markets and fundamentals align on a comfortable double-digit Democratic margin.
model.watch: Any public polling showing a single-digit race, a major scandal, or heavy outside spending against Huffman would be the first sign of a genuine contest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
This Northern California district has consistently favored Democrats by double digits, and Jared Huffman enters the general election as a well-funded incumbent with more than $1.1 million in cash on hand. Republican Robin Littau shows no reported fundraising and no outside support, and no expert ratings flag the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price Huffman's chances near certainty, and the district's partisan lean combined with incumbency points to a margin in the low twenties. The main source of uncertainty is the complete absence of public polling, which keeps the error band wide. Even a strong national Republican environment would need to swing this district by an unusual amount to put the outcome in doubt. Everything visible about the race points to Huffman's reelection.
